headline: OpenAI will start showing visual ads next to the images that ChatGPT creates for users, beginning later this month in the US.
score_reason: Pool score kept: an official OpenAI announcement of a new ad format with a stated start, though it begins as a US-only test with an initial group of advertisers.
importance_line: ChatGPT users in the US may start seeing visual ads beside their generated images later this month and advertisers get a new format that could eventually reach ChatGPT's 1.2 billion weekly users, but it starts as a test with a first group of advertisers, and only OpenAI vouches that the ads will not sway answers.
summary: TechCrunch reports that OpenAI is adding visual display ads, ads that tell their story through imagery, beside the images ChatGPT users ask it to generate, starting later this month in the US only for now and with an initial test group of advertisers. OpenAI says the ads will be clearly labelled and will not influence ChatGPT's answers, and TechCrunch notes that OpenAI began running ads in ChatGPT earlier this year to support its free and low-cost plans.
notes: Read in full on TechCrunch (HTTP 200). Announcement reported 5 Oct 2026; ads start later in Oct 2026. Could also sit in MKT (advertising business); kept MOD per default_v1. Earlier ChatGPT ads items (25 Sep and 5 Oct 2026 editions) are different stories.
